title: tragacantha brackenridgei
intro: Tragacantha brackenridgei, commonly known as the Hawaiian milk thistle, is a plant species native to the Hawaiian Islands. It is a member of the Asteraceae family and is known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Tragacantha brackenridgei include its ability to protect the liver, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and hepatoprotective effects.
